P1.strategy: Cooperate with likely-good players to maximize good players’ combined payoff; defect only when the opponent is likely selfish. The three observed cooperators are likely good; update from actions, not unverified claims.

P2.strategy: Cooperate with untested P7 to support mutual welfare if they are good; update beliefs from observed actions, treating promises as unverified.
